title: Fluidity
tagline: Fluidity makes NFTs liquid by creating NFT/Token pools which provide instant swaps
description:
Currently NFTs are traded on marketplaces like Opensea, Blur, MagicEden etc. Fluidity is trying to change that by providing NFT/token pools. Where users can swap one for the other without any need of having a buyer and seller.
